episodes.synopsis: The mysterious death of a soldier in Greece causes suspicion. Lloyd's sends Keaton as an insurance investigator.
episodes.title: Man in a Maze

episodes.synopsis: Bounty hunters stakes out a former German Red Army member, Rosa. Keaton is hired by her wealthy family to protect her.
episodes.title: Little Giant

episodes.synopsis: Keaton is hired to retrieve nine year old Flora from Italy. They flee for France where her mother waits.
episodes.title: Strange Tales of Lasagna

episodes.synopsis: Keaton saves the "immortal man" from the Russian Mafia. The man reveals the secret of the Romanov Treasures.
episodes.title: Immortal Man

episodes.synopsis: After being fired from a college in Tokyo, Keaton finds a job as an instructor at an adult education center in France. There he meets...
episodes.title: Paris Under the Roof

episodes.synopsis: Keaton meets Anna in Scilly Islands in England, who is protecting an archaeological site all by herself.
episodes.title: White Goddess

episodes.synopsis: Keaton, hoping to spend the summer vacation alone with Yuriko, heads for a farmhouse where he spent summers as a boy.
episodes.title: Memories of Summer Pudding

episodes.synopsis: Keaton heads for the countryside in England to rescue a kidnapped manager of a Japanese electronics corporation.
episodes.title: The Negotiator's Rule

episodes.synopsis: Keaton meets an arrogant old lady on a train from Germany to Switzerland who claims to be pursued by the Czech Secret Service.
episodes.title: Traveling with a Lady

episodes.synopsis: Keaton helps a childhood friend Charlie Chapman, also a world-renowned detective, with the murder case of an art dealer.
episodes.title: Charlie

episodes.synopsis: Keaton assists an Englishman to become a Chinese chef with the help of a secret recipe.
episodes.title: Special Menu

episodes.synopsis: Keaton and an elderly woman who loves detective movies pursue the truth behind a high-profile murder case.
episodes.title: A Case for Ladies

episodes.synopsis: A terrorist finds his conscience and seeks Keaton's help to locate and defuse two IRA bombs in a crowded London shopping mall.
episodes.title: A Peaceful Death

episodes.synopsis: Keaton helps a German businessman to locate his long-lost daughter while she seeks to avenge her mother's death in a labor camp in East Germany.
episodes.title: Wall in One's Heart

episodes.synopsis: An attack dog ruthlessly stalks Keaton deep in the mountains of Spain.
episodes.title: A Long and Hot Day

episodes.synopsis: Earl Fenders' bankruptcy leaves him a broken man, but his son, Robert, needs his fathers overbearing personality to inspire his music - can Keaton restore the father's domineering arrogance?
episodes.title: The Elm Tree Forever

episodes.synopsis: Edmond Layman was found murdered in his rose garden and his widow fears for her life. Their gardener, Eric, disappeared and is the chief suspect but Keaton soon unburies a thorny secret!
episodes.title: A Mansion of Roses

episodes.synopsis: Professor Bennington runs for Chancellor to save the college only to be targeted by a team of con men. But will the con men's professional pride lead them to change their minds?
episodes.title: Faker's Miscalculation

episodes.synopsis: Keaton's daughter meets a childhood friend who wants to free a hawk. Keaton and the boy's father secretly follow out of concern for the boy who also desperately wants to be free.
episodes.title: Into the Vast Sky...

episodes.synopsis: The Polish Mafia takes over Keaton's hotel in a blaze of gunfire. Although accused of being cowards for their inaction, Keaton and a secret legend use their experience to win despite the terrible odds.
episodes.title: The Island of Coward

episodes.synopsis: Keaton flies to Scotland to investigate a watch preserved in a shrine in Japan.
episodes.title: The Thistle Emblem

episodes.synopsis: Keaton visits Burgundy to insure the extraordinary vintage wine Chateau Lajonchee 1944.
episodes.title: Chateau Lajonchee 1944

episodes.synopsis: Keaton must escort a fugitive through a perilous road across a bottomless swamp.
episodes.title: No Way Out

episodes.synopsis: Keaton recalls the first time he met Daniel and became the insurance investigator 10 years ago...
episodes.title: The Day the Op Was Born
